fanzine-display.purpose: Current homepage only; uppercase, ink-worn title capped at 8.5rem, with a deliberate break below 600px.

fanzine-story.purpose: Homepage red story sheet; uppercase ink-worn headline with its own fixed line break.

fanzine-story-body.purpose: Homepage story paragraphs, capped at 46ch; no poster face on reading text.

fanzine-winner-name.purpose: Homepage paper-backed alumni only; not the larger featured portrait caption or sibling speaker name.

display.purpose: Original 2027-redesign homepage option, not current fanzine; at 900px use clamp(7rem, 12.3vw, 11rem). Uppercase.

edition.purpose: Original option's blue numeral beside the title, not the current red inline fanzine stamp.

headline.purpose: Fluid homepage section headings; siblings use their own fixed reading/task roles.

title.purpose: Bold Roboto news headings, distinct from Anton display.

body.purpose: Shared scoped reading text; guide content and disclosure paragraphs cap at 70ch.

label.purpose: Small bold metadata such as agenda times; not winner-year tabs.

winner-year.purpose: Uppercase Anton year above the portrait; original option uses blue/yellow, current fanzine uses charcoal/clean-paper.

read-title.purpose: Direct authored page title in the current red printed band; 3rem becomes 4rem at 600px, preserving IDs/year. Yellow band is the historical/base variant.

read-section.purpose: Fixed 2rem guide section heading; 70ch reading column, not a poster headline.

masterclass-title.purpose: Masterclass hero heading, followed by copy and the original course logo on mobile.

form-title.purpose: Fixed 2rem Anton title at every breakpoint; form-header padding increases from 24px to 32px at 900px.

field-label.purpose: Roboto labels and legends, kept distinct from Anton headings.

field-input.purpose: Roboto text inputs and textareas; neutral readable placeholders, native radio/conditional behavior retained.

motion.name: ticket-arrow
motion.purpose: Border-drawn arrow translates 4px on hover/focus; transition removed with reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes shared link-ticket arrow and homepage recording-link transitions, and disables smooth scrolling throughout the scoped theme; existing form reduced-motion rules remain.

components.name: Clean Supporting Form Card — Access Field Excerpt
components.description: Current unrotated clean-paper wrapper capped at 720px on charcoal. Fields have 24px inline margins and width:auto/min-width:0, preventing 100%-width-plus-margin clipping. This excerpt retains white native inputs, stable dark focus strokes, native invalid red, and red alias caret. Browser evidence: five routes use authored preview content; register-nyc/register-ban/confirm-ban/nyc-setup returned 404 locally, on main preview, and live, with no original HTML snapshots. Those four used browser-only synthetic block configurations with fake test logistics and example.invalid mocked endpoints; shipping source has no fixtures. Fixture-prefixed captures prove controller/styling behavior, not authored fidelity or route availability. CMS/404 sampleRUM repairs, deployment, and real backend delivery are unclaimed; all forms were mocked.

Other error/warning/success colors remain inherited. Final supplied checks: lint passed with six existing warnings, CSS lint passed, 12 focused tests passed, diff whitespace passed; 55 supporting cases (45 responsive/20 synthetic, seven mocked functional/five synthetic, three isolation) and 23 decoded captures. narrative.overview:
Electric fields, condensed lettering, rectangular tickets, and unboxed editorial content make the Rockstar surfaces feel like a concert bill. Practitioners and their real portraits supply the personality; the AEM Rockstar name and Adobe connection remain intact. Guides trade poster scale for readable hierarchy, while forms keep brand expression in compact headers and square controls.

The user-selected Cut-and-Paste Fanzine adds charcoal backing, cool paper sheets, rough red ink, slightly misregistered homepage Anton headlines, and monochrome genuine portraits. Its paper masthead and red lead story make one pasted-up issue; the real historical replay remains the action. The approved supporting-page extension shares this world through red printed bands and clean reading/form sheets, not a third aesthetic or a copy of the homepage composition.

This is a finished-build record, not an unconditional sitewide replacement. On `2027-redesign-option-2`, the homepage receives `body.rockstar-home.rockstar-grunge` and its recomposed hero; selected siblings receive `body.rockstar-inner.rockstar-grunge`, retaining their reading/course/form DOM structures. The loader includes the base, sibling (for inner pages), and grunge stylesheets. Yellow/blue Gig Poster primitives remain the unchanged base/historical option, not the current selected siblings' palette. Voting/results and commerce, product, cart, and test pages remain excluded. CMS-authored copy, IDs, imagery, form configuration, and endpoints remain authoritative where available. The extension reuses the two original Canvas print rasters and adds no raster, dependency, animation, controller, or AEM core change. The original `2027-redesign` branch remains the Gig Poster option.
keyCharacteristics: Historical yellow/blue Gig Poster base; current charcoal/paper/red Fanzine homepage and selected siblings.
Anton headlines paired with existing Roboto reading text.
Square actions and hairline divisions; unboxed grayscale course speakers, paper-backed homepage alumni, and clean reading/form sheets.
Native disclosures and brief, reduced-motion-aware feedback.
Shared identity with a tilted fanzine masthead and distinct reading, masterclass, and task-form hierarchies.

rules.name: The Field Contrast Rule
rules.body: On historical/base Gig Poster surfaces pair ink with yellow or off-white, and off-white with blue. On Fanzine pair charcoal with paper or red, and clean paper text with charcoal; supporting prose, agenda times, and controls use charcoal, not rough red as reading ink.

rules.name: The Scoped Ink Rule
rules.body: Preserve base yellow/blue tokens; Fanzine aliases apply only through the selected body/route gate. Homepage recomposition and rotation do not propagate to supporting reading or form structures.

rules.name: The Scoped Voice Rule
rules.body: Share Anton and the scoped Fanzine palette across prepared routes, not homepage display scale: fixed reading roles and compact form titles preserve comprehension and task clarity.

rules.name: The Flat Bill Rule
rules.body: Keep Gig Poster editorial containers and people unboxed; fanzine may use its native flat paper sheets and alumni backing. Neither world adds card elevation; retain hierarchy through material, fields, spacing, and thin rules.

dos: **Do** preserve historical/base Gig Poster tokens; use Fanzine aliases for the selected homepage/supporting routes, with recomposition and rotation confined to the homepage.
**Do** preserve genuine CMS imagery, portrait identity, recording destinations, and authorable structures.
**Do** retain dark visible supporting focus, native semantic controls, and reduced-motion behavior; keep confirmation instruction red scoped to its measured clean-paper context.
**Do** label historical recordings and guidance as historical; upcoming dates and registration remain unconfirmed.
**Do** retain the guide's 70ch measure, fixed reading hierarchy, compact form titles, clean unrotated prose/inputs, 24px form-child margins, and access fields' auto/min-width correction.
**Do** preserve inline symbols and block configuration; preparation strips only leading decorative emoji prefixes from direct prose headings, paragraphs, lists, and their list-item/emphasis text.
donts: **Don't** apply giant homepage display/edition sizes to guide or task-form headings, or retheme excluded routes.
**Don't** turn flat replay, news, or supporting-page people into rounded, shadowed card grids; homepage fanzine paper backing is native material, not permission for elevated cards.
**Don't** treat the working replay action as proof of upcoming registration or a confirmed lineup.
**Don't** treat preview tonal ramps in the sidecar as additional shipped palette tokens.
**Don't** reinterpret old masterclass dates, the 2026 guide, closed submissions, or mocked form responses as current availability or verified backend delivery.
